g.text: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module: ESP32-P4NRW32 + ESP32-C6 WiFi6, 16MB flash, 32MB PSRAM, crystals and core DCDC on the module. 3.3 V in.

g.desc: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module: ESP32-P4NRW32 + ESP32-C6 WiFi6, 16MB flash, 32MB PSRAM, crystals and core DCDC on the module. 3.3 V in.

g.text: Not a JLCPCB stock part: assembled without it, hand-soldered afterwards. The robot's only processor: motors and IMU over I2C, odometry over SPI, through the stack.

g.desc: Not a JLCPCB stock part: assembled without it, hand-soldered afterwards. The robot's only processor: motors and IMU over I2C, odometry over SPI, through the stack.

g.text: Pins by module EDGE: ToF/servos/LED left, odometry SPI + camera bottom, I2C/straps/UART right. One I2C bus, pull-ups here only.

g.desc: Pins by module EDGE: ToF/servos/LED left, odometry SPI + camera bottom, I2C/straps/UART right. One I2C bus, pull-ups here only.

g.text: GPIO36 pull-up and GPIO34 pull-down are mandatory.

g.desc: GPIO36 pull-up and GPIO34 pull-down are mandatory.
